GW150914.note: First ever direct detection. Two stellar-mass black holes, ~1.3 Gly away.

GW170814.note: First triple-detector observation; allowed sky localisation to ~60 deg².

GW170817.note: Binary neutron star — with optical/radio/X-ray counterpart (kilonova). Dawn of multi-messenger astronomy.

GW190521.note: Heaviest BBH detected at the time; remnant exceeds the pair-instability mass gap.

GW200105.note: Neutron star–black hole merger; the lighter component is consistent with a NS.
